findings: Six safe packages can inherit the full workspace lint table.
Five intentional Windows FFI packages retained local Rust lint tables and therefore did not inherit any workspace Clippy policy after their old Clippy tables were removed.
The workspace sets unsafe_code=forbid, which a source-level allow cannot override.
The eliot-installation diagnostics are real source findings because that package already inherits workspace lints.
The reported too_many_lines findings belong to the later extraction wave, while enum size, result size, documentation, and local control-flow findings require source-level treatment.
result.auditor_proposal: Use a per-group [lints.clippy] workspace=true table while retaining local [lints.rust] overrides.

accepted_findings: The five FFI packages must not remain without the effective workspace Clippy policy.
Lowering workspace unsafe_code=forbid is not justified by this migration.
eliot-installation source findings must not be disguised as inheritance problems.
rejected_or_corrected: Cargo does not support the proposed per-tool-group inheritance switch. Official Cargo documentation and the current Cargo diagnostic permit only top-level [lints] workspace=true with no overrides.
The accepted temporary mechanism is an exact explicit copy of the workspace Clippy policy in the five FFI manifests, tracked by swarm/challenges/W0-02-FFI-LINT-INHERITANCE.md.
integration_disposition.proof_ceiling: static manifest/source audit; focused and workspace clippy remain required
